summary:
星巴克本季 EPS 超預期14.5%，營收年增8.8%，轉型計畫初見改善。
• EPS 0.50 美元，較預估0.44超出14.51%。
• 營收9.53億美元（B級），年增8.79%回升。
• 「重返星巴克」轉型計畫帶動營運改善。
• 獲利優於預期顯示成本與門市效率優化見效。
ai_view:
訊號偏正面：EPS 大幅回升並超預期，營收年增轉強，顯示轉型計畫從低基期開始見效。短期股價受惠情緒改善，但77.76倍本益比已隱含高度復甦預期，容錯空間極小。中期關鍵在美國與中國同店銷售（SSS）能否持續轉正。追蹤指標：可比店銷售、客流量與客單價、營業利潤率與門市效率指標。屬高預期下的轉機股，需業績持續驗證。

需留意：本益比77.76極高，已反映轉型成功的高預期。；中國市場競爭與同店銷售壓力。；勞動成本與門市投資恐壓抑利潤率回升速度。

summary_en:
Starbucks beat EPS by 14.5% with 8.8% revenue growth, showing early turnaround progress.
• EPS of $0.50 beat the $0.44 estimate by 14.51%.
• Revenue of $9.53B rose 8.79% year over year.
• The 'Back to Starbucks' turnaround drove operational improvement.
• Better-than-expected profit shows cost and store-efficiency gains.

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: EPS rebounded sharply and beat, with revenue growth firming, indicating the turnaround is working off a low base. Near-term the stock benefits from improving sentiment, but a 77.76x P/E embeds high recovery expectations, leaving minimal margin for error. Mid-term hinges on US and China same-store sales turning sustainably positive. Track comparable sales, traffic and ticket, operating margin, and store efficiency. A turnaround story with high expectations needing continued proof.

Watch：A very high P/E of 77.76 prices in successful turnaround.; China competition and same-store-sales pressure persist.; Labor costs and store investment may cap margin recovery pace.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 較預估高出14.51%，營收年增8.79%顯示回穩。
